## Ctx.handleSessionCaptionArgsDocument() method

Optional `handleSessionCaptionArgsDocument` route handler declaration.

**Signature:**

```typescript
handleSessionCaptionArgsDocument?(): Promise<unknown>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;unknown&gt;

## Remarks

Executed on `document` updates while the session is active. Routing id=1 (session) runs BEFORE static/intent matching (id=2-3): it reads `ctx.getSession().method` — set via [Ctx.setSessionCaptionArgsDocument()](./gramstax.ctx.setsessioncaptionargsdocument.md) which wires [Ctx.methodSessionCaptionArgsDocument()](./gramstax.ctx.methodsessioncaptionargsdocument.md) — and dispatches this handler through `new Page(ctx)`<!-- -->. When no session is active, the same update falls through to the non-session route [Ctx.handleCaptionArgsDocument()](./gramstax.ctx.handlecaptionargsdocument.md) instead.
